name: Lantern Links
summary: Lantern Links is a calm pipe puzzle you play in the browser. Each level is a grid of pipe tiles around a glowing core. Tap a tile to rotate it and connect every lantern to the core, with no loops and no loose ends. Levels are generated endlessly, every one can be solved, and finishing within par earns three stars. Each level allows three undos, and the game has a timer, autosave and a layout that fits phones, tablets and wide screens. It is free and open source under the MIT license.
